title: Descent of rational paths to algebraic coefficient fibres
statement: For an IntegralFibrePathTransport, the rational paths extend to a linear path family on the actual algebraic fibre functor. On every displayed finite coefficient model its value is scalar extension of the rational path, through the exact recorded fibre object equalities. It satisfies identity, composition, conjugation and change of path. Definitions and hypotheses are those of [new-e5-integral-fibre-path-construction], [new-e5-rational-fibre-path-construction], [def-pod-lisse-adic-fibre-functors].

source.place: Weil II (1.1.1) b)-d), pp.146-147; explicit part of the fibre transport argument

proof.text: Whisker each rational path by the recorded category-value transport and scalar extension to Q. The rational scalar square and transport naturality prove compatibility with the raw coefficient comparisons, in particular those from the least field.

Normalization preserves the squares; thus the model components give a natural isomorphism of the concrete coefficient-pair functors. Descend it through localization. The component formula is exactly the scalar extension of the rational component.

Check all four path laws on localized pairs using the rational laws and functoriality of scalar extension. For a displayed rational model, cancel the two category-value transports; naturality along that object equality and the pure-tensor scalar map give the prescribed algebraic evaluation formula.

proof_origin.place: Weil II (1.1.1) b)-d); complete Lean construction for lem-wf-fibre-functor-basepoint-transport

theorem algebraicFibrePathFamily_evaluation (E : Padic.FiniteCoefficientFields l Q)
    (F : LisseRationalSheaf l E.val Y) (a : Q)
    (x : (lisseRationalFiberFunctor l E.val Y y).obj F) :
    eqToHom (lisseAlgebraicFiber_ofModel l Y z Q E F)
      (eqToHom (lisseAlgebraicFiberFunctor_obj l Y z Q (lisseAlgebraicOfModel l Y Q E F))
        (((algebraicFibrePathFamily l Y Q i).map y z t).hom.app
          (lisseAlgebraicOfModel l Y Q E F)
          (eqToHom (lisseAlgebraicFiberFunctor_obj l Y y Q
              (lisseAlgebraicOfModel l Y Q E F)).symm
            (eqToHom (lisseAlgebraicFiber_ofModel l Y y Q E F).symm
              (a ⊗ₜ[E.val]
                (eqToHom (lisseRationalFiberFunctor_obj l E.val Y y F) x)))))) =
      a ⊗ₜ[E.val]
        (eqToHom (lisseRationalFiberFunctor_obj l E.val Y z F)
          (((rationalFibrePathFamily l E.val Y (i.linear E)).map y z t).hom.app F x))
